newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs down sharply due to large-lot selling.
newsitem.headline: JGBs down sharply due to large-lot selling.

text.p: *Key June 10-year JGB futures down sharply in early Tokyo, due to large-lot selling of June contract. *Traders said sharp fall may have been due to speculative selling related to June JGB futures put options with a strike price of 123.00.
Open interest in the 123.00 June JGB futures put options totalled 12,564 contracts as of Monday's close.

There has been speculation in the market that hedge funds, rumoured to be holders of a large amount of the put options, may start selling the June JGB futures contract to bring the 123.00 June JGB futures in the money.
The June put options will expire at the end of this week.
The benchmark 182nd JGB yield stood at 2.640 percent, up from the previous day's close of 2.580 percent.
